item.title: Morning Brief, Sat 7 Nov 2026
item.description:

2. PSI proves the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture (Lean-checked): https://psi.inc/research/aaronson-ambainis/ and https://github.com/physical-superintelligence/aaronson-ambainis
3. Science's Last Exam (SLE) — agents score 37.5/100, 0 on end-to-end research: https://aitonomy.org/

6. Binance aims to finish remaining withdrawals by end of next week; Elliptic: ~$124M swapped to BTC: https://cryptobriefing.com/binance-withdrawal-restoration-next-week/
7. LINK soft near $10.70 while Binance futures lean long: https://blockchain.news/news/20261106-price-prediction-link-support-is-under-pressure-as-futures

Science
8. JWST UVLFs constrain neutrino self-interactions: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07013
9. Violent relaxation in hierarchical stellar systems → early massive black holes: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07546
10. ESA Hera first close-up of Didymos asteroids: https://www.esa.int/articles/about-us/directorates/operations/space-safety/hera/hera-s-first-close-up-view-of-didymos-asteroids

Not financial advice.
